phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M2HB .50 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .50 BMG (12.7×99mm) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 417 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 417 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 1143 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 8-groove bore and accelerates to 890 m/s (18100 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Barrel Tilt Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, barrel and slide recoil locked together before the lower cam lug tilts the breech downward to unlock.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 100-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M2HB .50 staged for its 450–575 RPM cyclic (with single-shot bolt latch) cadence.

zh.headline: 勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”）：1933 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 约翰·摩西·勃朗宁在第一次世界大战末期构思、1933 年定型为重型风冷枪管（HB）的 M2HB「Ma Deuce」堪称现代军工史上的活化石：它采用闭膛待击管退短后坐、加速子杠杆与可逆左右双侧供弹机匣，横跨百年服役至今仍无可替代。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M2HB .50 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1933 年问世的 勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”） 由美国约翰·勃朗宁 / 岩岛兵工厂 / FN主导研制，定位为经典的大口径重机枪。从二战 B-17 空中堡垒、谢尔曼坦克到 21 世纪 M1A2 SEP v3 遥控武器站，M2HB 即将迎来连续服役满一百周年的轻武器历史纪录。
约翰·摩西·勃朗宁在第一次世界大战末期构思、1933 年定型为重型风冷枪管（HB）的 M2HB「Ma Deuce」堪称现代军工史上的活化石：它采用闭膛待击管退短后坐、加速子杠杆与可逆左右双侧供弹机匣，横跨百年服役至今仍无可替代。 整件装备总长 1,656 mm（全长 1.66 m · 45 in 重枪管）、空重 38 kg，成为同期重机枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1933 年，美国约翰·勃朗宁 / 岩岛兵工厂 / FN推出了划时代的勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”）。从二战 B-17 空中堡垒、谢尔曼坦克到 21 世纪 M1A2 SEP v3 遥控武器站，M2HB 即将迎来连续服役满一百周年的轻武器历史纪录。 它的核心设计聚焦于短后坐枪管节套带动加速子杠杆将后坐动能倍增传递至重型枪机，动作沉稳澎湃，奠定了其在重机枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”） 的机械灵魂在于其「管退短后坐加速子杠杆 · 垂直升降闭锁楔块与闭膛待击双铲形握把」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，枪管与套筒短距共同后坐后由下凸耳引导枪管尾端下倾脱离闭锁槽，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。罕见的重机枪闭膛待击设计配合单发阻铁，赋予 2,000 米级远距点射狙击潜能，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”） 采用管退短后坐加速子杠杆 · 垂直升降闭锁楔块与闭膛待击双铲形握把。在每个击发周期中，枪管与套筒短距共同后坐后由下凸耳引导枪管尾端下倾脱离闭锁槽。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了罕见的重机枪闭膛待击设计配合单发阻铁，赋予 2,000 米级远距点射狙击潜能。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .50 BMG (12.7×99mm) 弹药规格与 1,143 mm（45 in）司太立内衬重枪管（8 条右旋 · 381 mm / 1:15 缠距），最高工作膛压约 417 MPa，可赋予弹头 890 m/s 的出膛初速与 18,100 J 动能，有效作用距离达 1830 米。
内膛技术特点方面，8 条重型膛线释放 18,100 J 恐怖枪口动能，1,830 米仍具轻装甲毁伤力。同时，标志性后置双铲形握把（Spade Grips）与拇指蝶形扳机，左右弹链进弹方向可现场互换，令其在 450–575 发/分（支持精确单发狙击模式） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 1143 毫米身管与 .50 BMG (12.7×99mm) 口径，勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”） 实现了每秒 890 米的初速与 1830 米有效射程。8 条重型膛线释放 18,100 J 恐怖枪口动能，1,830 米仍具轻装甲毁伤力，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 100 发容量的弹链受弹盘与挂弹箱体与 82 mm 膛轴设计，勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”） 将单发后坐冲量控制在 55.2 N·s 水平。油压后坐缓冲器吸收 55 N·s 巨额冲量，适配步兵三脚架、战车、舰艇与战机全平台。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-53）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 100 发容量的弹链受弹盘与挂弹箱体与出色的整体工效，油压后坐缓冲器吸收 55 N·s 巨额冲量，适配步兵三脚架、战车、舰艇与战机全平台。欢迎在 BAY-53 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 勃朗宁 M2HB .50 BMG 重机枪（“老干妈”） 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M2HB .50
paragraphs: Introduced in 1933 by John M. Browning / Rock Island Arsenal / FN in United States, the Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce” emerged as a defining Heavy Machine Gun. From WWII B-17 Flying Fortresses and Sherman tanks to 21st-century M1A2 CROWS turrets, the M2HB is approaching an unbroken century of front-line military service.

Conceived by John Browning at the close of WWI and standardized in 1933 with a Heavy Barrel (HB), the M2HB “Ma Deuce” uses closed-bolt short recoil, an accelerator lever, and reversible left/right belt feeding—serving unbroken for nearly a century. Measuring 1,656 mm (1.66 m OAL · 45 in Heavy Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 38 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Machine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1933, John M. Browning / Rock Island Arsenal / FN of United States introduced the Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce”. From WWII B-17 Flying Fortresses and Sherman tanks to 21st-century M1A2 CROWS turrets, the M2HB is approaching an unbroken century of front-line military service. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Short-recoil barrel extension drives a pivoting accelerator lever to cycle the massive bolt smoothly — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce” sits its Short-Recoil Barrel Extension & Accelerator Lever · Vertical Locking Block & Closed-Bolt Spade Grips. Throughout every firing cycle, barrel and slide recoil locked together before the lower cam lug tilts the breech downward to unlock, containing 417 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Closed-bolt firing and single-shot latch release grant astonishing long-range single-round accuracy, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce” relies on Short-Recoil Barrel Extension & Accelerator Lever · Vertical Locking Block & Closed-Bolt Spade Grips. During each cycle, barrel and slide recoil locked together before the lower cam lug tilts the breech downward to unlock. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Closed-bolt firing and single-shot latch release grant astonishing long-range single-round accuracy.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .50 BMG (12.7×99mm) with 1,143 mm (45 in) Stellite-Lined Heavy Barrel (8-Groove RH · 1:15" Twist), the Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce” develops 890 m/s muzzle velocity and 18,100 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 1830 meters.

Internally, 8-groove heavy bore unleashes 18,100 J muzzle energy capable of defeating light armor beyond 1,800 m. Combined with its 450–575 RPM cyclic (with single-shot bolt latch) tempo, Signature rear spade grips, butterfly thumb trigger, and field-reversible left/right belt feed, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .50 BMG (12.7×99mm) through its 1143 millimeter bore, the Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce” achieves 890 meters per second and 1830 meters of effective reach. 8-groove heavy bore unleashes 18,100 J muzzle energy capable of defeating light armor beyond 1,800 m.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 100-round ammunition belt feed tray & box with a 82 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 55.2 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Oil-buffer hydraulic shock absorber tames 55 N·s recoil across tripods, armor, naval, and air mounts.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-53), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.

Pairing its 100-round ammunition belt feed tray & box with disciplined recoil geometry, Oil-buffer hydraulic shock absorber tames 55 N·s recoil across tripods, armor, naval, and air mounts. Explore BAY-53 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Browning M2HB “Ma Deuce”.
